caption: The disk copies a 100 MB victim out in 2.01 s, then copies a 100 MB process in in 2.01 s. That 4.02 s total is 402 time slices of 10 ms, during which the CPU can only run other processes.

spec.aria: A timeline with two lanes: the disk copies a 100 MB victim out from 0 to 2.01 s and copies a 100 MB process in from 2.01 to 4.02 s, while the CPU lane shows other work for the whole 4.02 s, equal to 402 time slices of 10 ms.
